# Baholo Projects

Baholo Projects (Pty) Ltd is a South African Level 1 B-BBEE company founded in 2016 by Tshegofatso Goitseone Molapisi, the company's Founder and Managing Director, and formally registered in 2019.

## Services

- Industrial supplies: pipes, valves, pumps, fittings, bolts, nuts and other industrial components supplied to project requirements.
- Welding and fabrication: fabrication, modification and practical design of new and existing systems.
- Consulting: practical support to clarify industrial, fabrication and project requirements before delivery.
- Scaffolding: temporary access services scoped to the site and project brief.

## Pipework

Baholo Projects supplies pipework components and provides installation supported by fabrication or modification where required. The website explains five common considerations: connecting equipment, control and measurement points, branch distribution, overhead routing, and coordination around vessels and access structures.

Exact pipe type, material, size, service conditions, fittings, supports, joining method, tie-ins, testing and installation approach are confirmed during scoping and quotation. The supplied photographs are used as educational visual references rather than project case studies.

## Customers

Baholo Projects serves small and large enterprises in South Africa.

## Selected client experience

Baholo Projects has worked with Heineken. No project scope, dates or outcomes are published.
